body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md (v2, builds on SC-001). Do not edit either spec. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add scripts/build_history.py. It reads every PDF in the git-ignored folder samples/purchase-history/ with pdfplumber and writes samples/purchase-history.json.
Each bill keeps only: date (ISO), chain (keells), source (receipt), lines [{raw, qty, unit_lkr, amount_lkr}], promotions [{label, line, rate_bps, amount_lkr}], gross_lkr, net_lkr. Item descriptions that wrap onto a second line are joined. Amounts are integer LKR, rounded half up. Bills are sorted by date.
It never writes names, email addresses, branch names or addresses, bill, cashier, Nexus or card numbers, store phone numbers, or links. Output fields are whitelisted, not filtered.
A bill whose parsed lines do not sum to its Total Gross Amount within LKR 1 per line fails the build with the bill date.
Add fictional Cargills and Glomark bills in fixtures/v2/history-fictional.json with source fictional, Cargills often and Glomark rarely, over the same date range.
.gitignore gains samples/purchase-history/ (the local .git/info/exclude rule stays).
tests/test_history.py reads only the committed JSON files.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The committed history is de-identified and integer-valued. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_history.py::test_history_is_deidentified -q
2. Every bill's lines sum to its gross total within rounding. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_history.py::test_bill_lines_sum_to_gross -q
3. The PDFs are ignored by git. Verify: git check-ignore samples/purchase-history/
title: Build the de-identified purchase history from the e-bills
